cues: Semi modals supply the forms the nine modals lack.
Have to and had to for outside obligation.
Be able to, in every tense.
Used to for a past habit that has stopped: he used to smoke.
Be supposed to, for what is expected.
Careful with one pair: I used to go means a past habit; I am used to going means I am accustomed to it.
text: Semi modals supply the forms the nine modals lack. Have to and had to for outside obligation. Be able to, in every tense. Be allowed to for permission. Used to for a past habit that has stopped: he used to smoke. Be supposed to, for what is expected. And need and dare. Careful with one pair: I used to go means a past habit; I am used to going means I am accustomed to it.
